title: Characteristics of Patients Diagnosed With NSAID Sensitivity in Thailand
brief_summary: Study clinical characteristics and phenotypes of patients diagnosed with NSAID sensitivity in Thailand
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Thai patients with a history of an immediate reaction to aspirin/paracetamol, or NSAIDs visiting King Chulalongkorn memorial Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: Patients at least 15 years of age with a history of an immediate reaction to aspirin/paracetamol, or NSAIDs
